<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#1a3f4d">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Professionnels – DVK Studio | Partenaire projection immobilière Oise</title>
<meta name="description" content="DVK Studio aide agents immobiliers, investisseurs et artisans à valoriser leurs biens et accélérer leurs ventes grâce à la projection et l'aide à la décision. Oise, Somme, Aisne.">
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 64 64'%3E%3Crect width='64' height='64' rx='10' fill='%231a3f4d'/%3E%3Cpolyline points='18,38 32,20 46,38' fill='none' stroke='white' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/%3E%3Crect x='22' y='38' width='20' height='14' fill='none' stroke='white' stroke-width='2.8' rx='1'/%3E%3C/svg%3E" type="image/svg+xml">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Montserrat:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;background:#F7F3EE;color:#1C1A18;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden}
:root{--p:#225560;--pd:#1a3f4d;--pm:#2d6e7e;--t:#D96C4C;--tl:#e8835f;--tp:#F2C1B1;--cr:#F7F3EE;--be:#EDE8E0;--bm:#DDD8D0;--gr:#8C857C;--dk:#1C1A18;--wh:#fff;--r:6px;--r2:14px;--r3:22px;--s2:0 6px 32px rgba(34,85,96,.11);--s3:0 16px 64px rgba(34,85,96,.16);--ease:.3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}
.w{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
@media(max-width:640px){.w{padding:0 18px}}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:15px 30px;border-radius:var(--r);font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1.2px;text-transform:uppercase;transition:var(--ease);line-height:1;white-space:nowrap;border:none;cursor:pointer}
.btn-t{background:var(--t);color:var(--wh)}.btn-t:hover{background:var(--tl);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(217,108,76,.38)}
.btn-p{background:var(--pd);color:var(--wh)}.btn-p:hover{background:var(--pm);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn-ow{background:transparent;color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3)}.btn-ow:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.6)}
.arr::after{content:'→';font-size:14px}
nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:900;background:rgba(247,243,238,.96);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(34,85,96,.09);transition:box-shadow var(--ease)}
nav.up{box-shadow:var(--s2)}
.nav-w{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px;height:70px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px}
.logo-a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-decoration:none;flex-shrink:0}
.logo-circle{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--wh);border:2.5px solid var(--p);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;flex-shrink:0}
.logo-circle img{width:36px;height:36px;object-fit:contain}
.logo-txt strong{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:2.5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--pd);white-space:nowrap}
.logo-txt small{display:block;font-size:7.5px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:1.8px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gr);white-space:nowrap}
.nav-links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:26px;list-style:none}
.nav-links a{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1.3px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gr);text-decoration:none;transition:color var(--ease)}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(--pd)}.nav-links a.act{color:var(--t)}
.burger{display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;padding:8px;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0}
.burger span{display:block;width:22px;height:2px;background:var(--pd);border-radius:2px;transition:var(--ease)}
.burger.open span:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(7px) rotate(45deg)}
.burger.open span:nth-child(2){opacity:0}
.burger.open span:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg)}
.mob{display:none;position:fixed;top:70px;left:0;right:0;background:var(--cr);border-bottom:1px solid var(--bm);padding:14px 18px;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;z-index:899;box-shadow:var(--s2)}
.mob.open{display:flex}
.mob a{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gr);padding:13px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(34,85,96,.07);text-decoration:none;transition:color var(--ease)}
.mob a:hover{color:var(--pd)}
.mob-cta{background:var(--t)!important;color:var(--wh)!important;text-align:center;padding:14px!important;border-radius:var(--r);margin-top:10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;border:none;width:100%;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif}
@media(max-width:820px){.nav-links,.nav-cta-d{display:none}.burger{display:flex}.nav-w{padding:0 18px}}
@media(min-width:821px){.mob{display:none!important}}
.sec{padding:88px 0}
@media(max-width:640px){.sec{padding:60px 0}}
.g2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:64px;align-items:center}
@media(max-width:820px){.g2{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:36px}}
.fi{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px);transition:opacity .6s ease,transform .6s ease}
.fi.v{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
.d1{transition-delay:.08s}.d2{transition-delay:.16s}.d3{transition-delay:.24s}.d4{transition-delay:.32s}
#sticky{display:none;position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;background:var(--wh);border-top:1px solid var(--bm);padding:12px 18px;z-index:800;box-shadow:0 -4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.06)}
#sticky button{width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;background:var(--t);color:var(--wh);padding:14px;border-radius:var(--r);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1.2px;text-transform:uppercase;transition:background var(--ease)}
#sticky button::after{content:'→'}
@media(max-width:820px){#sticky{display:block}body{padding-bottom:70px}}
#cal-m{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1000;background:rgba(26,63,77,.85);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px}
#cal-m.open{display:flex}
.cal-box{background:var(--wh);border-radius:16px;width:100%;max-width:820px;max-height:90vh;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.cal-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:20px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bm);flex-shrink:0}
.cal-head h3{font-size:17px;color:var(--pd)}
.cal-head p{font-size:13px;color:var(--gr);margin-top:3px}
.cal-close{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cr);border:none;font-size:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--gr);cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0}
.cal-body{flex:1;overflow-y:auto}
.calendly-inline-widget{min-width:300px!important;height:680px!important}

/* HERO PRO */
#hero{position:relative;min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;padding-top:70px;overflow:hidden;background:url('data:image/jpeg;base64,') center center/cover no-repeat}
#hero::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(26,63,77,.92) 0%,rgba(26,63,77,.78) 50%,rgba(34,85,96,.65) 100%);z-index:0}
.hero-in{position:relative;z-index:1;max-width:700px;padding:72px 24px 96px}
.hero-back{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);text-decoration:none;margin-bottom:24px;transition:color var(--ease)}
.hero-back:hover{color:rgba(255,255,255,.85)}
.hero-back::before{content:'←';font-size:13px}
.hero-ey{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:rgba(34,85,96,.3);border:1px solid rgba(111,168,173,.4);color:rgba(111,168,173,.9);padding:7px 16px;border-radius:100px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2.5px;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:22px}
h1{font-size:clamp(34px,5.5vw,62px);font-weight:900;line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-1.5px;color:var(--wh);margin-bottom:20px;text-shadow:0 4px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--t)}
.hero-sub-p{font-size:17px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);line-height:1.75;margin-bottom:36px;max-width:560px}
.hero-ctas{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:40px}
.hero-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;max-width:460px}
.stat{background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:var(--r2);padding:16px;text-align:center;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.stat-num{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;color:var(--t);display:block;margin-bottom:4px}
.stat-label{font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.45)}
.arc-circle{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);pointer-events:none;z-index:1}
.ac1p{width:450px;height:450px;top:-120px;right:-100px}
.ac2p{width:280px;height:280px;top:18%;right:6%;border-color:rgba(111,168,173,.12)}

/* POUR QUI */
#pour-qui{background:var(--wh)}
.cibles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:48px}
.cible{background:var(--cr);border:1.5px solid var(--bm);border-radius:var(--r2);padding:22px 18px;text-align:center;transition:transform var(--ease),box-shadow var(--ease),border-color var(--ease)}
.cible:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--s2);border-color:rgba(34,85,96,.2)}
.cible-icon{font-size:28px;margin-bottom:10px}
.cible h3{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--pd);margin-bottom:5px}
.cible p{font-size:12px;color:var(--gr);line-height:1.55}
@media(max-width:820px){.cibles{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:480px){.cibles{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}

/* PROBLÈMES PRO */
#problemes{background:var(--pd);position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:88px 0}
#problemes::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.022) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.022) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:52px 52px;pointer-events:none}
.prob-grid-pro{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin-top:48px}
.prob-card-pro{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:var(--r2);padding:26px 22px;border-left:4px solid var(--t);backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.prob-icon{font-size:26px;margin-bottom:12px}
.prob-card-pro h3{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:var(--wh);margin-bottom:8px}
.prob-card-pro p{font-size:13.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.62);line-height:1.65}
@media(max-width:640px){.prob-grid-pro{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* COMMENT DVK AIDE */
#solution{background:var(--be)}
.usages{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px;margin-top:48px}
.usage{background:var(--wh);border:1.5px solid var(--bm);border-radius:var(--r2);padding:26px 22px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:transform var(--ease),box-shadow var(--ease)}
.usage:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--s3)}
.usage::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--p),var(--t));transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .4s ease}
.usage:hover::before{transform:scaleX(1)}
.usage-icon{font-size:28px;margin-bottom:14px}
.usage h3{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:var(--pd);margin-bottom:8px}
.usage p{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--gr);line-height:1.65}
@media(max-width:820px){.usages{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media(max-width:480px){.usages{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* EXEMPLES */
#exemples{background:var(--wh)}
.exemples-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin-top:48px}
.exemple{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--pd),var(--pm));border-radius:var(--r2);padding:28px 24px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.exemple::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.05) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:24px 24px;pointer-events:none}
.exemple-tag{font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--tp);margin-bottom:8px;display:block}
.exemple h3{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:var(--wh);margin-bottom:8px}
.exemple p{font-size:13.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);line-height:1.65}
.exemple-result{margin-top:14px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);font-size:13px;color:var(--tp);font-weight:600}
@media(max-width:640px){.exemples-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* FAQ PRO */
#faq{background:var(--pd);padding:88px 0}
.faq-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;margin-top:48px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border-radius:var(--r2);overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
.faq-item{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.faq-q{width:100%;background:none;border:none;padding:20px 24px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;transition:background var(--ease)}
.faq-q:hover,.faq-q.on{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.faq-qt{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--wh);line-height:1.5}
.faq-ic{color:var(--t);font-size:20px;font-weight:300;flex-shrink:0;transition:transform var(--ease);line-height:1;margin-top:1px}
.faq-q.on .faq-ic{transform:rotate(45deg)}
.faq-ans{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .4s ease}
.faq-ans.open{max-height:260px}
.faq-ansi{padding:0 24px 20px;font-size:13.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);line-height:1.78}

/* CTA */
#cta{background:var(--t);text-align:center;padding:88px 0;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
#cta::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 80% at 15% 50%,rgba(255,255,255,.08) 0%,transparent 55%),radial-gradient(ellipse 45% 65% at 85% 50%,rgba(0,0,0,.08) 0%,transparent 55%);pointer-events:none}
#cta .w{position:relative;z-index:1}
#cta h2{font-size:clamp(26px,4vw,44px);font-weight:700;color:var(--wh);margin-bottom:16px;letter-spacing:-.5px}
#cta p{font-size:16px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);max-width:500px;margin:0 auto 32px;line-height:1.75}
.cta-btns{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.cta-arch{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none}
.ca1{top:-60px;left:-60px;width:240px;height:240px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.ca2{bottom:-80px;right:-50px;width:320px;height:320px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09)}

/* FOOTER */
footer{background:var(--dk);padding:48px 0 0}
.foot-inner{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:36px;padding-bottom:36px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07)}
.foot-logo-a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-decoration:none;margin-bottom:14px}
.flc{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--wh);border:2.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;flex-shrink:0}
.flc img{width:38px;height:38px;object-fit:contain}
.flt strong{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:2.5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--wh);white-space:nowrap}
.flt small{display:block;font-size:7.5px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:1.8px;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.35);white-space:nowrap}
.foot-desc{font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);line-height:1.7;max-width:220px;margin-bottom:18px}
.foot-soc{display:flex;gap:8px}
.fsoc{width:34px;height:34px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:var(--r);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:var(--ease);text-decoration:none}
.fsoc:hover{background:var(--t);border-color:var(--t);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.fsoc svg{width:14px;height:14px;fill:rgba(255,255,255,.6)}
.fsoc:hover svg{fill:var(--wh)}
.foot-col h4{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1.8px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--wh);margin-bottom:14px}
.foot-links{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.foot-links a{font-size:12.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.38);text-decoration:none;transition:color var(--ease)}
.foot-links a:hover{color:var(--tp)}
.foot-bottom{padding:18px 0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.foot-bottom p{font-size:11.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.2)}
.foot-legal{display:flex;gap:16px}
.foot-legal a{font-size:11.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.2);text-decoration:none;transition:color var(--ease)}
.foot-legal a:hover{color:rgba(255,255,255,.5)}
@media(max-width:640px){.foot-inner{flex-direction:column;gap:28px}.foot-bottom{flex-direction:column;text-align:center}}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════
   SECTION PARTENAIRES
═══════════════════════════════════ */
.sec-partners {
  padding: 88px 0;
  background: var(--wh, #fff);
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
}
.sec-partners::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 50% at 50% 100%, rgba(34,85,96,.04) 0%, transparent 60%);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.partners-eyebrow {
  font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--t, #D96C4C); margin-bottom: 10px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px;
}
.partners-eyebrow::before, .partners-eyebrow::after {
  content: ''; width: 24px; height: 1.5px;
  background: var(--tp, #F2C1B1); display: block;
}
.partners-title {
  font-size: clamp(22px, 3vw, 36px); font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -.5px; color: var(--pd, #1a3f4d);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.partners-sub {
  font-size: 15px; color: var(--gr, #8C857C);
  line-height: 1.75; max-width: 520px; margin: 0 auto;
}

/* Bandes dégradées pour effet de fondu sur les bords */
.partners-track-wrap {
  position: relative;
  margin-top: 48px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.partners-track-wrap::before,
.partners-track-wrap::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 120px; z-index: 2;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.partners-track-wrap::before {
  left: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--wh, #fff) 0%, transparent 100%);
}
.partners-track-wrap::after {
  right: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(to left, var(--wh, #fff) 0%, transparent 100%);
}

/* Piste de défilement */
.partners-track {
  display: flex;
  gap: 28px;
  width: max-content;
  animation: scrollPartners 28s linear infinite;
  padding: 12px 0 20px;
}
.partners-track:hover {
  animation-play-state: paused;
}
@keyframes scrollPartners {
  0%   { transform: translateX(0); }
  100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
}

/* Carte partenaire */
.partner-item {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  text-decoration: none;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 160px;
  position: relative;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* Wrapper logo + tooltip */
.partner-logo-wrap {
  position: relative;
  width: 110px; height: 110px;
}

/* Logo placeholder (remplacé par un vrai <img> quand dispo) */
.partner-logo-placeholder {
  width: 110px; height: 110px;
  background: var(--cr, #F7F3EE);
  border: 2px solid var(--bm, #DDD8D0);
  border-radius: 16px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content:center;
  transition: all .3s ease;
  position: relative; z-index: 1;
}
.partner-item:hover .partner-logo-placeholder {
  border-color: var(--p, #225560);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(34,85,96,.14);
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  background: var(--wh, #fff);
}
.pl-icon { font-size: 36px; }

/* Tooltip description */
.partner-tooltip {
  display: none;
  position: absolute;
  bottom: calc(100% + 12px);
  left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: var(--pd, #1a3f4d);
  color: rgba(255,255,255,.88);
  font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
  font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.6;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  width: 220px;
  text-align: center;
  z-index: 100;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.2);
  pointer-events: none;
}
/* Flèche du tooltip */
.partner-tooltip::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  border: 7px solid transparent;
  border-top-color: var(--pd, #1a3f4d);
}
.partner-item:hover .partner-tooltip {
  display: block;
}

/* Nom et meta */
.partner-name {
  font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
  font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--pd, #1a3f4d);
  text-align: center; line-height: 1.3;
  transition: color .3s ease;
}
.partner-item:hover .partner-name { color: var(--p, #225560); }

.partner-meta {
  font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
  font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--gr, #8C857C);
  text-align: center;
  letter-spacing: .5px;
}

/* Sur mobile : ralentir le scroll */
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .partners-track { animation-duration: 20s; gap: 20px; }
  .partner-logo-placeholder { width: 90px; height: 90px; }
  .partner-logo-wrap { width: 90px; height: 90px; }
  .partner-item { width: 130px; }
  .pl-icon { font-size: 28px; }
  .partners-track-wrap::before,
  .partners-track-wrap::after { width: 60px; }
  /* Tooltip désactivé sur mobile (touch) */
  .partner-tooltip { display: none !important; }
}


.partner-logo-img {

  object-fit: contain;

.partner-item:hover .partner-logo-img {

  <div class="cal-box">
    <div class="cal-head"><div><h3>Réserver votre appel découverte</h3><p>20 minutes · Gratuit · Sans engagement</p></div><button class="cal-close" onclick="closeCal()">✕</button></div>
    <div class="cal-body"><div class="calendly-inline-widget" data-url="https://calendly.com/contact-dvkstudio/premier-contact?hide_gdpr_banner=1&primary_color=d96c4c"></div></div>

<script>
const _n=document.getElementById('nav');
window.addEventListener('scroll',()=>_n.classList.toggle('up',scrollY>24),{passive:true});
const _b=document.getElementById('burger'),_m=document.getElementById('mob');
_b.addEventListener('click',()=>{_b.classList.toggle('open');_m.classList.toggle('open')});
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(!_n.contains(e.target)&&!_m.contains(e.target)){_b.classList.remove('open');_m.classList.remove('open')}});
function tq(btn){const a=btn.nextElementSibling,o=a.classList.contains('open');document.querySelectorAll('.faq-q').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('on'));document.querySelectorAll('.faq-ans').forEach(a=>a.classList.remove('open'));if(!o){btn.classList.add('on');a.classList.add('open')}}
const _obs=new IntersectionObserver(es=>{es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('v');_obs.unobserve(e.target)}})},{threshold:.07,rootMargin:'0px 0px -20px 0px'});
document.querySelectorAll('.fi').forEach(el=>_obs.observe(el));
function openCal(){document.getElementById('cal-m').classList.add('open');document.body.style.overflow='hidden';if(!document.getElementById('cal-s')){const s=document.createElement('script');s.id='cal-s';s.src='https://assets.calendly.com/assets/external/widget.js';s.async=true;document.head.appendChild(s)}}
function closeCal(){document.getElementById('cal-m').classList.remove('open');document.body.style.overflow=''}
document.getElementById('cal-m').addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===document.getElementById('cal-m'))closeCal()});
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')closeCal()});
</script>
<script>
/* ── PARTENAIRES — Contenu tooltip + duplication piste ── */
(function() {
  const track = document.getElementById('partnersTrack');
  if (!track) return;

  // Remplir les tooltips avec data-desc
  track.querySelectorAll('.partner-item').forEach(item => {
    const desc = item.getAttribute('data-desc');
    const tip = item.querySelector('.partner-tooltip');
    if (tip && desc) tip.textContent = desc;
  });

  // Dupliquer les items pour le défilement infini
  const items = Array.from(track.children);
  items.forEach(item => {
    const clone = item.cloneNode(true);
    clone.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    // Remplir aussi le tooltip du clone
    const desc = clone.getAttribute('data-desc');
    const tip = clone.querySelector('.partner-tooltip');
    if (tip && desc) tip.textContent = desc;
    track.appendChild(clone);
  });
})();
</script>
